subject: Final acceptance choreography and signing windows — Orion Retail MAP
messages:
From: James Liu <james.liu@orion-retail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@orion-retail.com
Date: 2026-06-30T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Closing week — final MAP and signature timing

Neha —

Thanks for the detailed MAP draft. Procurement has two final asks before we can route to our legal signers:

1) A short acceptance window (how many business days after signature does activity start).
2) Confirmation of the approver list and signature order so we can prep internal routing.

Can you share the finalized MAP and a suggested signing cadence? We're targeting a July 6 start but want to confirm there's no blocker on Redwood's side.

Thanks,
James Liu
Director of IT Procurement
Orion Retail

[Attachment: Procurement_Questions.pdf (PDF, 54KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@orion-retail.com>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@orion-retail.com>, procurements@orion-retail.com
Date: 2026-06-30T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closing week — final MAP and signature timing

James —

Appreciate the quick read. I'm attaching the latest MAP and the SOW with explicit start-date logic. High level:

- Standard acceptance window: 5 business days post-signature for a smoke acceptance (config verification + basic stability checks).
- Production start (full traffic): we recommend a 10-business-day runway after signature to allow onboarding, entitlements, and a brief internal ops dry-run.
- Signing route: primary signer on Orion side -> procurement -> legal. On Redwood side we propose a single signature from our Head of Commercial, followed by operational kickoff.

I will loop in our commercial operations lead for exact signer availability. If July 6 is the desired start, signatures need to complete by EOD July 2 at the latest to allow prep.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.2.pdf, SOW_Orion_Retail_2026.docx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T19:02:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Closing week — final MAP and signature timing

Team —

Orion wants confirmation on acceptance windows and signer orchestration to hit July 6. Key asks from procurement:

- Can we commit to the 5-business-day smoke + 10-business-day full traffic plan?
- Who will sign on Redwood's side and what earliest signing date can we offer? 

I attached the MAP and SOW. Please reply with availability and any exceptions (SLA credits, start-date constraints, or DocuSign routing preferences).

Neha

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Closing week — final MAP and signature timing

Neha —

We can accept the proposed acceptance cadence. A couple notes:

- We should mark the operational kickoff as a "soft traffic" day for day 1 of the 10-business-day runway to reduce risk.
- On the commercial sign-off: I'm available to sign on July 2 afternoon (PDT); if we need earlier, Stephanie can sign July 1 morning.
- I'll update the Signature_Routing.xlsx with internal signers and preferred DocuSign order and share back.

I'll copy the finalized routing to you within 2 hours.

Grace
Director, Commercial Operations

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Closing week — final MAP and signature timing

Neha / Grace —

Routing sheet updated and attached. Final plan to share with Orion:

- Acceptance: 5 business days post-signature for smoke acceptance (config + KV cache validation).
- Ramp: 10 business days to full traffic; day 1 marked as soft traffic.
- Redwood signature: Stephanie Nguyen (Primary) — will sign via DocuSign on July 2 AM PDT. Grace will countersign operational acceptance items post-signature if needed.
- DocuSign envelope will be created by me and sent to Orion's primary signer (James Liu) with a 48-hour SLA for execution; procurement will then release the start-date.

I've attached Signature_Routing.xlsx and will create the DocuSign envelope link (attach when sent).

-Stephanie
Head, Commercial Contracts

[Attachment: Signature_Routing.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)]
